Your garbage disposal is a necessary appliance in your kitchen that often goes unnoticed. In fact, you may not even realize there is a problem with your garbage disposal until it malfunctions completely.
You might consider garbage disposal replacement or need repairs for various reasons. Fortunately, our professional plumbers at Fayette can handle all garbage disposal installation and repair services in Lexington and Elsmere , Kentucky. Reach out to us today to schedule service.
Garbage Disposal Installation & Replacement Services
If you’re building a new home, remodeling, or need to replace an old garbage disposal, consider installation and replacement services from Fayette. Our team of professionals can help you choose the right disposal for your home and quickly install it for you.
Other reasons you might consider a garbage disposal replacement include:
- Age: Older garbage disposals are more prone to breakdowns and become less efficient over time.
- Plumbing Upgrades: Remodeling or upgrading appliances in your kitchen is a great opportunity to replace your garbage disposal.
- Frequent Repairs: If your garbage disposal needs constant repairs, it’s probably time for a new one.
- Severe Damage: Severely damaged disposals, whether from a clog or foreign object, will likely need to be replaced.
Garbage Disposal Repair Services
Garbage disposals should be maintained on a regular basis to ensure full functionality and reliability. To avoid constant repair, steer clear from dumping the following down your garbage disposal:
- Grease, Oils, and Fats
- Fibrous Vegetables
- Eggshells
- Coffee Grounds
- Pasta
- And More!
If you do need garbage disposal repairs , Fayette is here for you. If your disposal is jammed, making strange noises, or unable to clear water backups, call one of our professionals for repair services. We can even provide drain cleaning services if the problem extends beyond the disposal.
At Fayette, we offer garbage disposal installation and repair services in Lexington and Elsmere, Kentucky. For more information or to schedule service, contact us today.
FAQs about Garbage Disposal Repair Services
How long do garbage disposals usually last?
Garbage disposals usually last about 10 to 12 years, depending on usage, maintenance, and quality. In Lexington, KY, Fayette Heating & Air provides professional garbage disposal services, including installation, repair, and replacement using trusted brands like InSinkErator and Moen to ensure long-lasting, efficient kitchen performance.
Is it easy to replace a garbage disposal yourself?
Replacing a garbage disposal can seem straightforward, but it often involves working with electrical wiring, plumbing connections, and mounting systems under the sink. Tasks like disconnecting the old unit, installing a new disposal, sealing the flange, and reconnecting the drain line require precision. Many homeowners in Lexington, Bowling Green, and Elsmere choose professional garbage disposal replacement services to avoid leaks, electrical hazards, or improper installation.
Do you need a plumber or electrician to replace a garbage disposal?
In most cases, a licensed plumber handles garbage disposal replacement because the job involves sink plumbing, drain lines, and proper sealing. However, since a disposal unit connects to your home’s electrical system, an electrician may be needed if wiring upgrades or a new outlet is required. Fayette Heating & Air provides professional installation to ensure safe and proper operation.
What are signs my disposal needs replacing?
Common signs your garbage disposal needs replacement include frequent clogs, unusual grinding noises, persistent odors, leaks under the sink, or the unit failing to turn on. Older disposal units in Lexington, Bowling Green, and Elsmere homes often lose efficiency over time, leading to repeated repairs. When repairs become frequent, replacement is usually more cost-effective.
What is the main reason for garbage disposal not working?
The most common reason a garbage disposal stops working is a jam caused by food debris, grease buildup, or non-food items like utensils. This can overload the motor or trigger the reset switch. Other causes include electrical issues, worn-out components, or a tripped circuit breaker. Improper use can shorten the lifespan of the disposal unit.
Is a broken garbage disposal an emergency?
A broken garbage disposal is not always an emergency, but it can become urgent if it causes leaks, drain backups, or foul odors. If water is leaking under the sink or backing up into your kitchen, prompt service is important to prevent water damage. Fayette Heating & Air provides timely garbage disposal services in Lexington, Bowling Green, and Elsmere to restore normal function.
